description: This file defines a base class for interacting with Google Cloud Storage (GCS) buckets within a larger AI/ML project. It includes methods for constructing request headers with access tokens, downloading and deleting objects from GCS, and handling bucket/folder paths. The class also manages Vertex AI authentication and supports dynamic logging configuration.

classes.name: GCSBucketBase
classes.description: A base class for managing interactions with GCS buckets, including authentication, object retrieval, and deletion, tailored for use within a Vertex AI / Google Cloud environment.

methods.name: None __init__(self, bucket_name: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs)
methods.description: Initializes the GCSBucketBase instance, setting up the HTTP client, bucket name, and credentials.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] construct_request_headers( self, service_account_json: Optional[str], vertex_instance: Optional[VertexBase] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs authorization headers by obtaining access tokens asynchronously for GCS API requests.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] sync_construct_request_headers(self)
methods.description: Constructs authorization headers synchronously using environment variables for GCS API requests.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str] _handle_folders_in_bucket_name( self, bucket_name: str, object_name: str, )
methods.description: Handles bucket names with folder postfixes, splitting them into bucket name and object prefix.

methods.name: GCSLoggingConfig get_gcs_logging_config( self, kwargs: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = {} )
methods.description: Retrieves the GCS logging configuration, using dynamic parameters if available, or default environment variables.

methods.name: VertexBase get_or_create_vertex_instance( self, credentials: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a cached Vertex AI instance, ensuring access tokens are available.

methods.name: str _get_in_memory_key_for_vertex_instance(self, credentials: Optional[str])
methods.description: Generates a cache key for Vertex instance based on credentials, defaulting to 'IAM_AUTH' if none provided.

methods.name: download_gcs_object(self, object_name: str, **kwargs)
methods.description: Downloads an object from GCS asynchronously, returning its content or None on error.

methods.name: delete_gcs_object(self, object_name: str, **kwargs)
methods.description: Deletes an object from GCS asynchronously, returning the server response or None on error.

methods.name: _log_json_data_on_gcs( self, headers: Dict[str, str], bucket_name: str, object_name: str, logging_payload: Union[StandardLoggingPayload, str], )
methods.description: Uploads logging data as JSON to GCS using POST requests.
